id: title:Gilbert09:tell users to replace a token vercel rejects

review.posthog_relevance: Preserves distinction between user input and internal failure, potentially improving incident triage and user-facing error messages.
review.reason: Adds ASCII-only token rejection and a generic Vercel credential validation exception. This could preserve the distinction between user input and internal failure, potentially improving incident triage and user-facing error messages.
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the assumption that these changes prevent UnicodeEncodeError from escaping as an internal error and preserve the distinction between user input and internal failure, which is not independently verified. No adoption or incident avoidance is demonstrated.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No score assigned; tier requires assessment of broader implementation and validation, not just this chunk.

observations.behavior: Adds ASCII-only token rejection before HTTP request; this prevents UnicodeEncodeError from escaping as an internal error.
